# Restaurant

![The dining room with its wooden ceiling and a view of the forest](../../../assets/restaurant.jpg)

Our kitchen cooks with produce from the Engadin and the Bregaglia valley: capuns, pizokel, air-dried Grisons beef and fish from Lake Sils. The restaurant is also open to guests who are not staying at the hotel.

## Opening hours

Every day from 12 noon to 2 pm and from 6.30 pm to 9.30 pm. The five-course dinner menu costs CHF 98.

## Reservations

Book your table on +41 81 555 01 20. The current [menu as a PDF](/speisekarte.pdf) lists every dish and its allergens.
